title: The spectral gap of the ABJM model: A holographic perspective from uplifted higher-dimensional geometries
summary: We study the $U(1)^4$ charged black brane solution of four-dimensional gauged supergravity and analyze the fermionic response in this geometry, which is holographically dual to $3d$ $\mathcal{N}=2$ SCFT ABJM models. Similar to \cite{DeWolfe:2013fha}, we show that a gap exists in the states of the conformal field theory, which corresponds to the different limiting behaviors of the two unequal chemical potentials of the four-charge geometry.
